title: Pill & Syringe Sort
description: Sort vibrant medicine capsules into color-matched syringes with crisp liquid-sort logic—quirky medical visuals meet ultra-clean puzzle satisfaction.
controls: Tap a syringe to pick up its top capsules, then tap a matching or empty syringe to transfer them.

zh-CN.title: 药丸与针管
zh-CN.description: 创意爆款分类排序药丸与针管：把五彩小药丸按颜色精准装入对应透明针管，脑洞题材配经典排序超解压！
zh-CN.controls: 点击针管取出顶部彩色药丸，再点击同色或空针管归类装满即可过关。
